findings.title: configuration.md tells non-ECL110 installs to leave the topics blank; they ship non-empty and publish every cycle
findings.claim: docs/configuration.md:457 ('Leave blank if you do not have one') and :70 ('default sensibly when absent') contradict the shipped defaults and docs/ecl110.md:79-82, which says to clear both topics or every cycle attempts an MQTT publish and logs the failure.
findings.mechanism: const.py ships DEFAULT_ECL110_DISPLACE_SET_TOPIC='ecl110/flow_temp_control/displace/set' and DEFAULT_ECL110_COMMAND_TOPIC='ecl110/command'; coordinator.py awaits async_publish_current_action(reason='scheduled_update') in the actuation step of every cycle, and async_publish_ecl110_command returns early only when BOTH topics are empty, otherwise calling hass.services.async_call('mqtt','publish',...) and logging _LOGGER.error on any exception. The only page that says so is the one non-owners are told is not for them. For D6/D10: in Home Assistant an unregistered service raises ServiceNotFound, so an install without the MQTT integration logs an ERROR every interval; tests/harness.py:FakeServices.async_call returns None for unregistered services, so no test can observe it.

findings.title: Comments: one misnamed service, one bound the constant does not enforce, three comments that restate the next line
findings.claim: open_meteo.py:66-69 says surface GHI 'cannot exceed' the ~1361 W/m2 solar constant beside _MAX_PLAUSIBLE_GHI = 1400.0; thermal_model.py:191 names 'the set_thermal_params service' (it is set_thermal_parameters); coordinator.py:4353, optimizer.py:671 and thermal_model.py:1830 carry single-line comments that only restate the next line.
findings.mechanism: Of 872 strict and 209 loose symbol references in production comments/docstrings and 248+42 in the card, all resolve after vetting except the misnamed service; of 65 constants whose attached comment cites a number, all agree under the listed conversions after vetting except the GHI ceiling, whose comment states a bound 39 W/m2 below what the constant admits without saying why. Two prose roundings ('less than half' for 0.55, 'a third' for 0.3 in defrost.py) are noted, not counted. Long comment blocks (515) sampled with seed 5 (24) are precise and explain why; none was wrong.
